propositions: An APFS RAM disk was created for macOS pytest temporary trees to reduce Gerrit Verify and runner wall time, following precedent from Apple Git CI and Aeron workflows.
Measurement of retained temp across default and integration tiers showed ~2.17 GiB total, requiring a 2 GiB RAM disk with 50% headroom to avoid memory pressure below 40% of physical memory.

All four RAM-disk treatment runs (31869753711, 31869919362, 31870391571, 31873067707) were slower than the no-RAM control run 31868300174, missing the predeclared 5% or larger-of-range retention threshold.
Owner-nonwritable workflow snapshot fixtures in tests/unit/workflow/snapshot_fixtures prevented ordinary recursive basetemp cleanup, requiring explicit permission restoration before removal.
Nested pytest in the cleanup oracle inherited cacheprovider, leaking REPO_ROOT entries; adding -p no:cacheprovider to the subprocess oracle fixed the hygiene defect.
